name: Atuin Shell History
description: Installs Atuin shell history tool and mounts host config and data directories. Enables shell integration for bash and zsh with up-arrow disabled. Sync is disabled (host handles syncing). Never starts its own Atuin daemon; uses the host daemon when its socket is in the mounted data directory, otherwise writes history directly.

version.description: Version of Atuin to install ('latest' or a specific version number like '18.4.0')

debug.description: Print every command install.sh runs (set -x), useful for diagnosing an install failure.
